seo_title: Robinhood Chain: Where We Are | Chill with R2 Ep 01
meta_description: Chill Pill and R2D2 recap Robinhood Chain's first months: the Entropy Advisors dashboard, asset flows, Token2049 expectations and launching tokens on Mosh.
summary: In the first CR2 episode, hosts Chill Pill and R2D2 look back at how the Robinhood Chain thesis has played out since summer and read the Entropy Advisors dashboard to see where money has moved on the chain. They then cover what to watch at Token2049, the PONS listing news, and how token launches work on Mosh.
takeaways: The hosts argue that this onchain season started with Robinhood Chain and that Robinhood treats the chain as a growth area, with a large app user base that has not yet been offered crypto assets onchain.

On the Entropy Advisors dashboard, the hosts focus on the asset landscape rather than TVL alone: value held in protocol tokens fell from its early September peak while stablecoins on the chain kept growing.
They see Robinhood Chain on Arbitrum as a proof of concept that could lead other TradFi trading platforms to follow with their own onchain plans.
Coinbase adding PONS to its roadmap is not the same as a listing, and the hosts would rather a listing came with wider market momentum than act as the only catalyst.
Chill Pill explains why launching a token on Mosh is more complex than buying one: the creator settings and the agent bundle are meant to produce healthier charts than tokens bundled by insiders.
